notes: The terrain's look target (docs/scenery/LOOK_TARGET.md; roadmap D10): the owner's six screenshots of Kingdom Come: Deliverance II's countryside, 6 Nov 2026. A quality bar only: the pictures are the publisher's, kept on the owner's PC in the folder below (git-ignored), never committed, traced, sampled or recreated. tools/plot_lab.py shows them beside the renders where the PC has them, with the traits as a checklist.

pictures.shows: a rutted track between wheat, dipping to a village in a fold of wooded hills
from a hilltop meadow over a valley floor to ridges fading in steps
fields of different states side by side, from dappled shade
standing wheat on a crest, a lone broad tree, wooded hills to the horizon
a valley meadow, a worn track and a stony brook
a worn path past a pond with reeds and a willow, dense cover

traits.name: Relief at every scale
traits.target: rolling ground near and far; a track dips and climbs; banks and hollows near the eye

traits.name: Land use follows the ground
traits.target: woods on slopes and crests, fields on gentle ground, meadows on valley floors

traits.name: Patches with soft edges
traits.target: fields of different states, uneven edges, grass margins and balks

traits.name: Edges layered and closed
traits.target: a wall of leaves from the ground up, no trunks seen from outside, an uneven outline

traits.name: Trees that read as trees
traits.target: clumped foliage, dark inside, each species its own silhouette

traits.name: Ground cover dense to the horizon
traits.target: grass and herbs everywhere not worked, never a bare texture

traits.name: Crops as volume
traits.target: a crop a mass of plants with a soft edge, darker into its depth

traits.name: Tracks worn into the ground
traits.target: two ruts and a grass median, sunk a little, grassy shoulders

traits.name: Things that give scale
traits.target: stones, branches, fences, poles, sheds, stacks, animals

traits.name: Light
traits.target: warm sun, blue sky light in the shadows, occlusion in foliage, dappled shade

traits.name: Sky and air
traits.target: cumulus with form and their shadows; far ridges bluer and paler; no brown haze

traits.name: Colour and value
traits.target: muted natural greens, a full range of value, the ground's colour in patches

traits.name: Water with its banks
traits.target: reeds, still reflections, a willow; a stony brook bed

traits.name: Every distance has its detail, and no seams
traits.target: near, middle and far each detailed; no ring where the cover ends, no grid
